name: SpeechParaling-Bench-Baseline
description: A collection of paralinguistic tasks built on speech recordings that measure models' ability to recognize non-linguistic information from audio (e.g., emotion, speaker traits, and other prosodic/paralinguistic labels). The benchmark provides baseline splits and metrics to evaluate classification and regression-style paralinguistic inference from raw speech. It is intended to standardize comparison of models on common speech‑paralinguistic tasks.
reputation: A niche baseline dataset used in speech paralinguistics research for benchmarking basic paralinguistic classifiers; modest community adoption.
